messages.subject: Skylark - where we are after Caldera's mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Caldera have come back exactly where we expected - £4.5m upfront and £6m cap. Robert told Grace he'd accept both to land it before year end, so let's give the numbers and hold firm on the warranty awareness qualifier and the uncapped IP indemnity. Elena, please prep v3 tracking only those points. James to send.

Sarah
